historical_result.upstream_divergence: Step 3 Press Enter returned success, but steps 4 and 6 still showed the homepage with the search value and without the edit link.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen search actions 1-6, then read-only location, search-form and target-link observations at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no edit-link click or post mutation

source_mechanism.pre_fix: The v1.1.6 input_dispatch.rs Enter branch inserted a newline for textarea or activated a button/link, but had no implicit form-submission path for a focused search input.
source_mechanism.fix: The later input_dispatch.rs identifies an Enter character phase on a form-associated blocking input and performs implicit submission through the default submit button or the form submit path.

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原第 7 步的链接超时不是布局故障：更早的第 3 步虽报告按下 Enter，搜索表单却未提交，后续快照一直停在首页，因此编辑链接根本没有出现。同一冻结搜索前缀下，官方 1.1.6 五秒后仍在首页且搜索框保持焦点；固定候选进入带查询参数的搜索页并出现目标链接。源码对照显示旧版 Enter 分支只处理文本域换行和按钮/链接激活，没有搜索框的隐式表单提交；修复提交增加了通用隐式提交路径及无提交按钮搜索表单的回归测试。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The step-7 link timeout was not a layout failure. Earlier, step 3 reported pressing Enter without submitting the search form; subsequent snapshots stayed on the homepage, where the edit link did not exist. With the same frozen search prefix, official 1.1.6 remained on the homepage with the input focused after five seconds, while the fixed candidate navigated to the query-bearing search page and exposed the link. Source comparison shows that the old Enter branch handled textarea newlines and button/link activation but lacked implicit submission for search input; the later commit added a general implicit-submission path and a regression test for a search form without a submit button.

scope_limit: Read-only same-site 1.1.6-versus-fixed prefix diagnosis, not a full formal 1.1.3 rerun or proof that the complete original post-edit trajectory succeeds. The historical official score remains unchanged.
